AutoDisablePolicy.description: The auto-disable policy configuration for the image pipeline.

FailureCount.description: The number of consecutive failures after which the pipeline should be automatically disabled.

EcrConfiguration.description: Settings for Image Builder to configure the ECR repository and output container images that are scanned.

ContainerTags.description: Tags for Image Builder to apply the output container image that is scanned. Tags can help you identify and manage your scanned images.

RepositoryName.description: The name of the container repository that Amazon Inspector scans to identify findings for your container images. The name includes the path for the repository location. If you don't provide this information, Image Builder creates a repository in your account named image-builder-image-scanning-repository to use for vulnerability scans for your output container images.

ImageScanningConfiguration.description: Determines if tests should run after building the image. Image Builder defaults to enable tests to run following the image build, before image distribution.

EcrConfiguration.description: Contains ECR settings for vulnerability scans.

ImageScanningEnabled.description: This sets whether Image Builder keeps a snapshot of the vulnerability scans that Amazon Inspector runs against the test instance when you create a new image.

ImageScanningTypes.description: The type of vulnerability scan that Image Builder runs for AMI output when ImageScanningEnabled is true. Specify a single value. If you omit ImageScanningTypes, Image Builder uses TEST_INSTANCE_CVE. With TEST_INSTANCE_CVE, Amazon Inspector scans the test instance during image tests, and you must activate Amazon Inspector for Amazon EC2 scanning in your account. With ON_DEMAND_AMI_CVE, Amazon Inspector starts an on-demand scan of the output AMI during image tests. You must build from an image recipe, but you do not need to activate Amazon Inspector in your account.

ScanResultCondition.description: The condition that the output AMI's scan results must meet for the image to pass. You can set ScanResultCondition only when ImageScanningTypes is ON_DEMAND_AMI_CVE. If you omit it, Image Builder starts the scan but does not wait for it or use its results to pass or fail the image.

ImageTestsEnabled.description: Defines if tests should be executed when building this image.

TimeoutMinutes.description: The maximum time in minutes that tests are permitted to run.

PipelineLoggingConfiguration.description: The logging configuration settings for the image pipeline.

ImageLogGroupName.description: The name of the log group for image build logs.

PipelineLogGroupName.description: The name of the log group for pipeline execution logs.

ScanResultCondition.description: The condition that the output AMI's scan results must meet for the image to pass. When you set it, the test phase waits for the scan to finish, and Image Builder fails the image if a counted finding exceeds MaximumSeverityLabel.

FixAvailable.description: Specifies whether only findings that have a fix available count toward MaximumSeverityLabel. When false, Image Builder counts every finding. The default is true.

MaximumSeverityLabel.description: The maximum severity allowed for findings on the output AMI. A finding above this severity fails the image, unless FixAvailable excludes it.

Schedule.description: The schedule of the image pipeline.

AutoDisablePolicy.description: The auto-disable policy for the image pipeline.

PipelineExecutionStartCondition.description: The condition configures when the pipeline should trigger a new image build.

ScheduleExpression.description: The expression determines how often EC2 Image Builder evaluates your pipelineExecutionStartCondition.

Timezone.description: The timezone that applies to the scheduling expression, for example "Etc/UTC" or "America/Los_Angeles" in IANA timezone format. If not specified, this defaults to UTC.

WorkflowConfiguration.description: The workflow configuration of the image

OnFailure.description: Define execution decision in case of workflow failure

Parameters.description: The parameters associated with the workflow

WorkflowArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the workflow

WorkflowParameter.description: A parameter associated with the workflow

WorkflowParameterValue.description: The value associated with the workflow parameter

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the image pipeline.

ContainerRecipeArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the container recipe that defines how images are configured and tested.

DeploymentId.description: The deployment ID of the pipeline, used for resource create/update triggers.

Description.description: The description of the image pipeline.

DistributionConfigurationArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the distribution configuration associated with this image pipeline.

EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled.description: Collects additional information about the image being created, including the operating system (OS) version and package list.

ExecutionRole.description: The execution role name/ARN for the image build, if provided

ImageRecipeArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the image recipe that defines how images are configured, tested, and assessed.

ImageScanningConfiguration.description: Contains settings for vulnerability scans that Amazon Inspector runs against the test instance during image creation.

ImageTags.description: The tags to be applied to images created by this pipeline.

ImageTestsConfiguration.description: The image tests configuration of the image pipeline.

InfrastructureConfigurationArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the infrastructure configuration associated with this image pipeline.

LoggingConfiguration.description: The logging configuration settings for the image pipeline.

Name.description: The name of the image pipeline.

Schedule.description: The schedule of the image pipeline.

Status.description: The status of the image pipeline.

Tags.description: The tags of this image pipeline.

Workflows.description: Workflows to define the image build process
